newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Tractor says HK offer 296 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: First Tractor says HK offer 296 times subscribed.

text.p: Chinese tractor maker First Tractor Co Ltd said on Thursday its Hong Kong public offering of H-shares was 296.4 times subscribed, prompting reallocation of 58.5 million shares from the international placement.
The company said it received applications for 13.34 billion H-shares compared with the 45 million shares available for public subscription in Hong Kong.
H-shares are Chinese enterprises' shares listed in Hong Kong.
Trading in the company's shares is due to begin on June 23.
First Tractor issued 300 million H-shares at HK$4.50 each in a global offering -- 255 million shares for international placement and 45 million shares for the Hong Kong public offer.
Due to the oversubscription, the company has reallocated 58.5 million shares to the public offer tranche from the international placement, it said.

Peregrine Investments Holdings Ltd subscribed for 15 million shares under the placing, while the Henan provincial government's Hong Kong investment arm Henan Hongkong Enterprises Ltd subscribed for 12 million shares, First Tractor said.
